narr: Several rounds of storms moved through Marion County during the early morning hours of July 17th causing isolated areas of flash flooding.
ev: Up to four inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding. Several sections of U.S. Highway 51 were flooded north of Sandoval.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING WAS REPORTED ALONG PORTIONS OF U.S. HIGHWAY 51 JUST NORTH OF SANDOVAL. SEVERAL LOCATIONS WERE CLOSED DUE TO WATER OVER THE HIGHWAY.
